glosses: Having the power of driving or impelling; giving an impulse; moving; impellent.

examples.text: Poor men! poor papers! We and they / Do some impulsive force obey.

glosses: Actuated by impulse or by transient feelings; inclined to make rapid decisions without due consideration.

examples.text: Americans are not libertarians in the Cato Institute sense of the word, but they are folk libertarians in this sense of impulsive behaviour, which is a feature of American life that anyone who wants to govern the United States, Democratic or Republican, has to be aware of.
